cards.text: Jeremiah, the LORD's prophet, is bound in chains among all the captives of Jerusalem and Judah who are being exiled to Babylon. At Ramah, Nebuzaradan, Babylon's captain of the guard, finds him. Chains on your wrists and the man in charge walks up, and baker, I'd be sweating right through my apron.

Then Nebuzaradan tells Jeremiah that the LORD his God decreed this disaster on this place. A Babylonian captain explaining the LORD's word to the LORD's prophet is like somebody forwarding you your OWN email.

cards.question: Nebuzaradan says the LORD has done just as He said. What reason does he give for this disaster?

answers.text: The people sinned and did not obey Him
The king of Judah broke his treaty
Babylon simply had a bigger army

cards.text: Then Nebuzaradan says, "But now, behold, I am freeing you today from the chains that were on your wrists." Baker, I waited YEARS in a junk drawer for a sentence like that.

cards.question: Now that Jeremiah's chains are off, Nebuzaradan says Jeremiah has to come with him to Babylon.
Nebuzaradan lets Jeremiah choose whether to come to Babylon. If Jeremiah comes, what does Nebuzaradan say he will do?

cards.text: And if Babylon doesn't seem right to Jeremiah, Nebuzaradan says the whole land is before him, so he can go wherever seems good and right. That's like getting called into the boss's office expecting the WORST and walking out with the keys to the whole building.
Before Jeremiah turns to go, Nebuzaradan adds one more option. He can return to Gedaliah son of Ahikam, the son of Shaphan, and stay with him among the people.

cards.question: Nebuzaradan says Gedaliah has been appointed over the cities of Judah by the king of ___.
Before he releases Jeremiah, Nebuzaradan gives him a ration and a gift.
Jeremiah is free, with the whole land to choose from. Where does he go?

cards.text: Jeremiah stays with Gedaliah among the people who were left in the land. The man gets offered BABYLON with somebody to take care of him, and he says, "Nah, I'm good right here."

Word reaches the commanders and men of the armies still out in the field. The king of Babylon has put Gedaliah in charge of the poorest of the land, the men, women and children who weren't exiled to Babylon.

cards.question: When the army commanders in the field hear about Gedaliah, they come to him at Mizpah.

cards.text: They bring their men, too. In the group are Ishmael son of Nethaniah, Johanan and Jonathan the sons of Kareah, and several other commanders.

cards.question: Gedaliah swears an oath to the commanders and tells them not to be afraid to serve the Chaldeans, the Babylonians.

cards.text: Gedaliah tells them, "Live in the land and serve the king of Babylon, and it will go well with you." And he SWORE on it, which is more promise than every warranty card in my old junk drawer put together.

cards.question: Gedaliah says he will stay in Mizpah. What will he do there for the commanders and their men?

answers.text: Train them for the next battle

cards.text: Then he tells them to gather wine grapes, summer fruit and oil, store them in jars, and live in the cities they have taken. Everything just fell apart, and this man is handing out harvest chores like the coworker who walks in after the office floods and says, "Okay. Who's got a mop?"

Jews living in Moab, Ammon, Edom and all the other lands hear that the king of Babylon left a remnant in Judah and put Gedaliah over them. News like that travels faster than the smell of a fresh batch.

cards.question: The Jews out in Moab, Ammon, Edom and the other lands hear about the remnant under Gedaliah. What do they do?

cards.text: They come back from all the places they'd been banished to, and they gather an abundance of wine grapes and summer fruit. Baker, people coming home AND a big harvest coming in has me getting misty under the chef's hat.
Meanwhile, Johanan son of Kareah and all the army commanders come to Gedaliah at Mizpah. And baker, they did NOT come to talk about grapes.

cards.question: Johanan and the commanders warn Gedaliah that Baalis king of the Ammonites has sent Ishmael son of Nethaniah to ___ him.
Gedaliah believes the commanders' warning about Ishmael.

cards.text: Gedaliah doesn't believe them. Then Johanan son of Kareah speaks privately to Gedaliah at Mizpah, and you KNOW it's serious when somebody says "Hey, got a minute?" and closes the door.

cards.question: Talking privately with Gedaliah at Mizpah, what does Johanan offer to do about Ishmael?
Johanan warns that if Ishmael takes Gedaliah's life and scatters the people gathered to him, the remnant of Judah would ___.
When Johanan offers to deal with Ishmael, Gedaliah answers, "Do not do such a thing!"

cards.text: Gedaliah tells Johanan that what he's saying about Ishmael is a lie. Baker, the oven timer hasn't gone off on this one yet, so keep that apron on.
